title: Two builds, two destinations
summary: Change one part of an illustrative build design and see which problem it solves.
intro: Imagine two processes producing an archive at the same time. This small design example asks where each process writes its output.

intro.caption: Keep the processes in place; change their destinations.

sections.heading: What does a separate path establish?
blocks: In the second design, the two archive paths are different. That separates these output files. It does not establish how inputs are shared or how a later publication step chooses an archive. Those are different relationships to explain.
The drawings are authored states of an illustrative design. Playback shows the comparison; it does not execute a build.
